use_cases.name: View any record, report or chart as at a past date
use_cases.goal: Let an authorised user see a record, report or organisation chart as it was known on a chosen recorded date and as effective on a chosen valid date, with the differences highlighted.

stakeholders.interest: Can reconstruct exactly what the organisation knew when a decision or payroll run was made.
Can explain why a closed run used a value that has since been corrected.
Historical views never expose more of their record than the viewer's current scope allows.

use_cases.trigger: A user opens the time-travel control on a record, report or organisation chart and selects two dates.
preconditions: All temporal facts are written as new versions with valid and recorded intervals; none are updated in place (RL-020).
The user holds a grant covering the entity, location and payroll group of the data requested (RL-004).
postconditions_success: The user sees the view as at the chosen recorded and valid dates, with every changed attribute marked and its change source shown.
The as-at query, its two dates and the viewer are written to the audit ledger.
postconditions_failure: No historical data outside the viewer's present scope is returned and the reason is stated on screen.

main_flow.action: Opens the record of E1020 Arjun Bhat and selects the time-travel control.
Chooses a recorded-at date of 2026-09-05 and a valid-at date of 2026-09-04, and a comparison point of today.
Resolves the viewer's effective scope as the intersection of tenant, entity, location, line and payroll group.
Reads every attribute version where valid_at and recorded_at fall inside the stored intervals.
Renders both views side by side and highlights attributes that differ, naming the change request or event that wrote each.
Drills from a highlighted attribute to its version chain to see who recorded it and when.
Switches the same dates onto the Peenya Works organisation chart or a headcount report.
Records the as-at query, both dates and the viewer in the audit ledger.

alternate_flows.condition: The user selects only a valid-at date.
steps: The platform defaults recorded-at to now, showing the latest knowledge about that effective date.

alternate_flows.condition: The view is a payroll report for a closed run.
steps: The platform defaults both dates to the run's snapshot timestamp so the report matches the run exactly (RL-021).

exception_flows.condition: The record was in a payroll group outside the viewer's grant on the chosen date.
exception_flows.handling: Compensation attributes return null for the whole history and the view states that they are outside scope.

exception_flows.condition: The chosen recorded-at date precedes the tenant's data migration date.
exception_flows.handling: The platform shows the migrated baseline version and labels it as the earliest available knowledge.

nfrs: An as-at read of one person record returns in under 1 s at p95.
An as-at organisation chart for 5,000 positions renders in under 4 s.

user_stories.want: to see a record exactly as it was known on a past date
user_stories.so_that: I can test whether a decision used the information available at the time

acceptance.given: E1020's shift group was corrected on 2026-09-10 with effect from 2026-09-01
acceptance.when: I view the record recorded-at 2026-09-05, valid-at 2026-09-04
acceptance.then: I see the shift group before the correction and a marker linking to the 2026-09-10 change

acceptance.given: I hold read-only auditor scope for LE-01
acceptance.then: no edit or save action is offered

user_stories.want: a closed run's report to open at its snapshot timestamp by default
user_stories.so_that: my figures always match what the run actually used

acceptance.given: the September 2026 PLANT-BLR run was snapshotted at 2026-09-28 18:00
acceptance.when: I open its headcount report in as-at mode
acceptance.then: both dates default to 2026-09-28 18:00 and the count equals the run's population

acceptance.given: an assignment for E1022 was back-dated after the snapshot
acceptance.when: I compare the snapshot view with today
acceptance.then: E1022 is highlighted with the back-dated change named

user_stories.want: the organisation chart of a site on a past date
user_stories.so_that: I can answer who reported to whom when an incident happened

acceptance.given: Rekha Deshpande (E1021) became Assembly manager at Peenya Works on 2026-08-01
acceptance.when: I view the Peenya chart valid-at 2026-07-15
acceptance.then: Assembly shows the previous manager and no node for E1021 in that role

acceptance.when: I request the Medchal Works chart
acceptance.then: the chart is refused and the message names the missing entity grant

use_cases.name: Publish a policy change through automated regression
use_cases.goal: Store every configurable leave, attendance, payroll and eligibility policy as a versioned, testable definition and block publication until the golden test suite shows no unexplained difference.

stakeholders.interest: No policy edit silently changes a payslip figure.
Policy changes go live on the intended effective date with evidence of testing.
Every published policy version carries its test result and approver.

use_cases.trigger: A consultant saves a draft change to a policy definition, such as the late-mark grace for the PLANT12 shift group.
preconditions: The policy exists as a versioned definition with an effective date (RL-020).
A golden test suite with expected outcomes exists for the policy family.
A publication approval chain is configured for policy changes (RL-010).
postconditions_success: The new policy version is published with its effective date, test run identifier, explained differences and approver recorded.
Affected attendance or payroll periods after the effective date are queued for recompute.
postconditions_failure: The draft remains unpublished; the live version is unchanged and the failing cases are listed.

main_flow.action: Opens the policy in the configuration workspace and edits a parameter, for example grace from 15 to 10 minutes.
Sets the effective date and saves the draft as a new version.
Runs the golden suite for the policy family against the current and draft versions on identical inputs.
Lists every case whose outcome changed, with before and after values and the employees and days affected.
Marks each expected difference as explained with a reason linked to the change request.
Confirms no unexplained difference remains and submits the draft to the approval chain.
Reviews the difference summary and approves publication.
Publishes the version, end-dates the prior one and queues recompute for affected periods.

alternate_flows.condition: The consultant wants to add new golden cases for the changed behaviour.
steps: The consultant adds cases with expected outcomes; the platform reruns the suite.

alternate_flows.condition: The approver returns the change with a comment.
steps: The draft returns to the consultant with the reason recorded.

exception_flows.condition: At least one difference is unexplained.
exception_flows.handling: Publication is blocked; the submit action stays disabled and the unexplained cases are listed.

exception_flows.condition: The effective date falls inside a locked payroll period.
exception_flows.handling: Publication is refused for that date and the consultant must choose the next open period.

nfrs: A golden suite of 2,000 cases for one policy family completes in under 5 minutes.
Every published policy version can be traced to its test run and approver in one click.

user_stories.want: every draft policy to be regression-tested automatically
user_stories.so_that: I see the impact of a change before anyone is paid differently

acceptance.given: a draft lowering PLANT12 grace from 15 to 10 minutes
acceptance.then: the suite runs and lists the 12 golden days whose disposition changes from present to late

acceptance.given: all 12 differences are explained
acceptance.then: the draft enters the approval chain with the test run attached

user_stories.want: publication blocked while any difference is unexplained
user_stories.so_that: a policy edit cannot quietly change pay

acceptance.given: a draft with one unexplained change in overtime minutes for E1018
acceptance.then: submission is refused and E1018's case is shown as unexplained

acceptance.given: a published version
acceptance.then: I see the test run identifier, explained differences and approver

user_stories.want: affected periods recomputed automatically when a policy goes live
user_stories.so_that: attendance already derived reflects the new rule from its effective date

acceptance.given: a grace change effective 2026-10-01 published on 2026-10-05
acceptance.then: attendance days 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-04 for PLANT12 workers are queued for recompute

acceptance.given: September 2026 is locked
acceptance.then: publication is refused and the message names the locked period

use_cases.name: Publish and install a governed extension
use_cases.goal: Allow a tenant or partner to package a custom screen, workflow or tool with declared permissions and data scopes, pass automated security review and be installed into a tenant without widening any user's access.

stakeholders.interest: Extensions cannot read data beyond what is declared and approved.
Client-specific needs can be met without changing the core product.
Every installed extension, its permissions and its actions are on record.

use_cases.trigger: A consultant submits an extension package, for example a canteen coupon screen for Peenya Works, to the tenant catalogue.
preconditions: The extension is built against the published extension interface and declares its screens, tools, events and data scopes.
The tenant admin holds the extension-installation permission.
postconditions_success: The extension is installed at a pinned version with only its declared, approved scopes; all its actions write to the action ledger.
postconditions_failure: The package is rejected or left uninstalled, and no permission or data scope is granted.

main_flow.action: Uploads the extension package with its manifest of screens, tools, events and requested data scopes.
Runs automated review: manifest schema, dependency scan, static checks and a sandboxed test against synthetic data.
Produces a review report listing requested scopes, any finding and a pass or fail verdict.
Reviews the report and the requested scopes, and narrows them where broader than needed.
Approves installation for chosen entities and locations, for example LE-01 at LOC-PLA only.
Creates a service principal for the extension owned by a named human and limited to the approved scopes.
Installs the pinned version and records the installation in the audit ledger.
Uses the extension screen; each call passes through the policy gate and is logged.

alternate_flows.condition: A new version of an installed extension is submitted.
steps: The platform reruns review and shows scope changes compared with the installed version; the tenant admin approves or declines the upgrade.

alternate_flows.condition: The admin wants a trial first.
steps: The extension is installed only in the sandbox tenant for evaluation.

exception_flows.condition: Automated review finds a critical vulnerability or an undeclared outbound call.
exception_flows.handling: The package is rejected with findings and cannot be installed.

exception_flows.condition: No accountable human owner is named for the extension principal.
exception_flows.handling: Installation is blocked until an owner is named.

exception_flows.condition: The extension requests a compensation field outside the user's payroll group.
exception_flows.handling: The policy gate returns null for the field and logs the attempt.

nfrs: Automated review of a package completes in under 15 minutes.
An installed extension adds no more than 50 ms at p95 to the screen it extends.

user_stories.want: to see and narrow the scopes an extension requests before installing it
user_stories.so_that: an extension never gets more access than it needs

acceptance.given: an extension requesting attendance for all locations
acceptance.when: I approve it for LOC-PLA only
acceptance.then: its principal can read Peenya Works attendance and nothing at Chakan Works

acceptance.given: an extension principal with no named owner
acceptance.then: installation is blocked with a message citing the owner requirement

user_stories.want: automated security review on every package I submit
user_stories.so_that: I learn about problems before a client admin sees the package

acceptance.given: a package making an undeclared outbound call
acceptance.then: the verdict is fail and the call target is listed as a finding

acceptance.given: a clean package
acceptance.then: a pass verdict is issued with the requested scopes listed

user_stories.want: every extension action recorded in the action ledger
user_stories.so_that: I can attribute any data access by an extension

acceptance.given: the canteen extension read 340 attendance rows on 2026-10-12
acceptance.when: I filter the action ledger by that extension
acceptance.then: I see the read with its principal, owner, scope and row count

acceptance.given: an extension version is upgraded
acceptance.then: both versions, approval dates and approvers are listed

use_cases.name: Consolidate multi-entity reporting across currencies
use_cases.goal: Support several legal entities and currencies in one tenant and produce consolidated workforce cost reports converted at dated exchange rates.

stakeholders.interest: Sees group workforce cost in one reporting currency.
Conversions use the correct rate for the date of each transaction and are reproducible.
Entity payroll stays in its own functional currency.

use_cases.trigger: Finance requests the group workforce cost report for a period.
preconditions: Legal entities LE-01 and LE-02 are configured with a functional currency, and a reporting currency is set for the tenant.
Exchange rates with effective dates are loaded for every currency pair used in the period.
The requesting user holds grants for all entities included (RL-002).
postconditions_success: A consolidated report is produced with entity amounts in functional currency, converted amounts in reporting currency and the rate and rate date used per line.
postconditions_failure: The report is not produced for lines with a missing rate; the missing pairs and dates are listed.

main_flow.action: Selects the period, entities LE-01 and LE-02, the reporting currency and the rate type (month-average or period-end).
Reads posted payroll results and cost lines per entity in each entity's functional currency.
Looks up the exchange rate effective for each line's date and rate type.
Converts amounts using integer minor units and records rate, rate date and rounding per line.
Eliminates inter-entity recharges flagged for elimination and totals by entity, site and cost centre.
Reviews the consolidated view and drills to any entity or line.
Exports the report; the export is logged with the rate set version used.

steps: Conversion is skipped and the report states that no conversion applied.

alternate_flows.condition: Finance wants to compare with a different rate type.
steps: The platform recomputes the conversion with the chosen rate type and shows both side by side.

exception_flows.condition: No rate exists for a currency pair on a line's date.
exception_flows.handling: Those lines are listed as unconverted and the report is marked incomplete until a rate is loaded.

exception_flows.condition: The user lacks a grant for one selected entity.
exception_flows.handling: That entity is excluded and the report header states the exclusion.

nfrs: A consolidated report for two entities and 12 months completes in under 30 s.
Reproducing a report with the same rate set version yields identical figures to the minor unit.

user_stories.want: group workforce cost converted at the rate for each line's date
user_stories.so_that: consolidated figures are accurate and auditable

acceptance.given: an overseas service entity paid in another currency with a month-average rate loaded for October 2026
acceptance.when: I run the October group report in INR
acceptance.then: each line shows the converted amount, the rate and the rate date

acceptance.given: no rate is loaded for 2026-10-31
acceptance.when: I request the period-end rate type
acceptance.then: the affected lines are listed as unconverted and the report is marked incomplete

user_stories.want: one consolidated cost view for both Vindhya entities
user_stories.so_that: I can compare entity and site cost without manual spreadsheets

acceptance.given: LE-01 and LE-02 with posted September payrolls
acceptance.then: I see totals per entity, per site including Oragadam Works and a group total

acceptance.given: an inter-entity recharge flagged for elimination
acceptance.then: the recharge does not inflate the group total

user_stories.want: each entity's payroll to stay in its functional currency
user_stories.so_that: statutory and payslip amounts are never affected by reporting conversion

acceptance.given: the consolidated report converts LE-02 figures
acceptance.when: I open the LE-02 payroll register
acceptance.then: all amounts remain in INR exactly as computed

acceptance.given: a rate is corrected after a report was exported
acceptance.then: a new rate set version is recorded and the earlier export remains reproducible

use_cases.name: Classify, extract and confirm employee documents
use_cases.goal: Store employee documents with type classification, expiry tracking and extraction of key fields that a human confirms before anything is written to the record.

stakeholders.interest: Documents are kept securely and their details are recorded correctly.
Less manual keying, with control over what is written to the record.
Expiring statutory and identity documents are renewed on time.

use_cases.trigger: An employee or HR uploads a document such as a PAN card, driving licence or educational certificate.
preconditions: Document classes with expiry applicability and reminder intervals are configured.
The uploader has access to the person record within their scope (RL-004).
postconditions_success: The document is stored with class, confidence and expiry; confirmed field values are written as new record versions with source and confirmer recorded.
postconditions_failure: The document is stored but no field is written to the record; unconfirmed items remain in the verification queue.

main_flow.action: Uploads a scan of a driving licence from the self-service document area.
Stores the file encrypted, scans it for malware and records the uploader and timestamp.
Classifies the document type and extracts name, number, issue date and expiry date with a confidence per field.
Compares extracted values with the current record and shows matches, differences and low-confidence fields.
Reviews each field, corrects any errors and confirms the values to be written.
Writes confirmed values as new record versions citing the document and the confirmer.
Schedules expiry reminders for the document and its owner.
Sends reminders to the employee and HR before the expiry date.

alternate_flows.condition: The document type is not recognised.
steps: The document is classed as unclassified and HR chooses the class manually.

alternate_flows.condition: HR rejects the document as illegible.
steps: The employee is asked to upload a clearer copy; nothing is written.

exception_flows.condition: An extracted value differs from a previously verified value.
exception_flows.handling: The verified value is kept; the difference is shown and can only be changed by explicit HR confirmation.

exception_flows.condition: The malware scan flags the file.
exception_flows.handling: The file is quarantined, not shown to any reviewer and the uploader is told to re-upload.

nfrs: Classification and extraction complete in under 20 s for a two-page scan.
No extracted value reaches the person record without a recorded human confirmation.

user_stories.want: extracted document fields presented for my confirmation
user_stories.so_that: I avoid retyping while staying in control of the record

acceptance.given: a PAN card uploaded for E1066 Abhinav Rastogi with the number extracted at 0.97 confidence
acceptance.then: the number is pre-filled, matched against the record and awaits my confirmation

acceptance.given: an extracted date of birth with 0.62 confidence
acceptance.then: the field is flagged low confidence and is not pre-selected for writing

user_stories.so_that: I renew it before it affects my duties

acceptance.given: a forklift operator licence for E1035 expiring on 2026-12-31 with reminders at 60, 30 and 7 days
acceptance.then: E1035 and Peenya HR receive the 60-day reminder

acceptance.given: a renewed licence is uploaded and confirmed
acceptance.then: pending reminders for the old licence are cancelled

user_stories.want: to see who confirmed each value taken from a document
user_stories.so_that: I can verify that extraction was reviewed by a person

acceptance.given: a bank account number written from a cancelled cheque
acceptance.then: I see the document, extraction confidence, confirmer and confirmation time

acceptance.given: an agent extraction
acceptance.then: the agent's extraction is listed as a proposal with no direct write to the record

use_cases.name: Register visitors and control gate entry and exit
use_cases.goal: Register visitors at a site, issue time-bound passes, record entry and exit at the gate and link each visit to its host employee for safety and security audit.

stakeholders.interest: Knows who is on site at any moment for safety and evacuation.
Can pre-register visitors quickly and is told when they arrive.
Safety induction and identity checks are recorded for every visitor.

use_cases.trigger: A host employee pre-registers a visitor, or a visitor arrives at the gate without pre-registration.
preconditions: The site has gates configured with gate points and pass validity rules.
The host is an active employee at the site.
postconditions_success: The visit is recorded with visitor identity, host, pass validity, entry and exit times and safety induction acknowledgement.
postconditions_failure: Entry is refused or the pass is closed, and the reason is recorded against the visit.

main_flow.action: Pre-registers a supplier visitor for 2026-11-12 10:00–13:00 at Peenya Works with purpose and areas to be visited.
Creates the visit, issues a time-bound pass code and sends it to the visitor.
At the gate, scans the pass and verifies the visitor's photo identity.
Shows the site safety induction; the visitor acknowledges it and the acknowledgement is recorded.
Records entry time and gate point and notifies the host that the visitor has arrived.
Records exit at the gate when the visitor leaves.
Closes the visit and updates the live on-site register.

steps: Gate staff register the visitor at the kiosk and the host approves entry from a notification.

alternate_flows.condition: The pass expires while the visitor is still on site.
steps: The platform alerts the host and gate staff; the host extends the pass or escorts the visitor out.

exception_flows.condition: The pass is outside its validity window or already used for exit.
exception_flows.handling: Entry is refused and the attempt is recorded against the visit.

exception_flows.condition: The host does not respond within 10 minutes for an unregistered visitor.
exception_flows.handling: The request routes to the host's manager and entry stays on hold.

nfrs: Pass verification at the gate completes in under 3 s.
The on-site register reflects entries and exits within 30 s for evacuation use.

user_stories.want: to pre-register a visitor and be told when they arrive
user_stories.so_that: I can meet them at the gate without delay

acceptance.given: I pre-registered a visitor for 10:00–13:00 on 2026-11-12
acceptance.when: the visitor's pass is scanned at Gate 1 at 09:52
acceptance.then: I receive an arrival notification naming the gate

acceptance.given: the visitor's pass is valid only on 2026-11-12
acceptance.then: entry is refused and the attempt is logged

user_stories.want: a live list of every visitor on site
user_stories.so_that: I can account for everyone during an evacuation drill

acceptance.given: 7 visitors entered and 2 exited Peenya Works today
acceptance.then: it lists 5 visitors with host and entry time

acceptance.given: a visitor's pass expired at 13:00 without an exit record
acceptance.then: the host and gate staff receive an overstay alert

user_stories.want: proof that every visitor acknowledged the site safety induction
user_stories.so_that: a safety audit can be answered from records

acceptance.given: a visitor who has not acknowledged the induction
acceptance.when: gate staff try to record entry
acceptance.then: entry cannot be recorded until acknowledgement is captured

acceptance.given: a month of visits
acceptance.then: each row shows the acknowledgement time and the host employee
